about: Site-added papers that are NOT part of the Awesome-RSI catalog. The catalog's systematic screening thins after June 2026. Entries were found by keyword matching Hugging Face Daily Papers (basis: title) or by the weekly arXiv candidate search (basis: abstract) and classified provisionally by this site; papers were not read in full. Levels L1-L5 and families follow the catalog's taxonomy but are this site's judgement and may be wrong. Remove an entry once the catalog covers it.

papers.t: Frontis-MA1: Training an AI4AI Model towards Recursive Self-Improvement in Machine Learning Engineering
papers.why: The title describes training an AI model for machine-learning research with recursive self-improvement as the goal, which points to improving the research process itself.

papers.t: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research
papers.why: The title describes a recursively self-improving deep-research agent, i.e. an agent that improves its own research workflow.

papers.t: AREX-2: Advancing Self-Improving Agents through Long-Horizon Reflective Tasks
papers.why: Self-improving agents trained on long-horizon reflective tasks: the agent keeps what it learns for later behaviour, inside a fixed procedure.

papers.t: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
papers.why: Regularised recursive self-improvement of agent harnesses: the harness-improvement procedure itself is being improved and constrained.

papers.t: ModularRSI: Modular and Generalizable Recursive Harness Self-Improvement
papers.why: A modular, generalisable recursive self-improvement method for agent harnesses; the title points to improving the improvement loop.

papers.t: NeoHorse-1: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement via Agentic Post-Training with Routing Harness
papers.why: Agentic post-training with a routing harness aimed at recursive self-improvement: the system chooses how to train, while the objective stays external.

papers.t: HarnessDev: Can LLMs Create and Evolve Their Own Agent Harness?
papers.why: Asks whether LLMs can create and evolve their own agent harness, so the AI picks the improvement, with acceptance still set outside.

papers.t: DarwinX: Evolving Agent Harnesses Through Natural Selection
papers.why: Evolves agent harnesses by natural selection: the search strategy is the AI's, while the selection criterion is external.

papers.t: RSIGame: Autonomous Agentic Game Development with Recursive Self-improvement
papers.why: Autonomous agentic game development with recursive self-improvement; the artifact being improved is a game built by the agent.

papers.t: Scaling Automatic Research Agents via World Models
papers.why: Scaling automatic research agents with world models: improving the research process rather than a single task.

papers.t: False Frontiers: Diagnosing and Mitigating Co-Cheating in Self-Evolving Search Agents
papers.why: Studies "co-cheating" in self-evolving search agents, i.e. how the learner and its feedback interact, which shapes what it learns next.

papers.t: AgentGarten: Code Worlds for Evolving Agents
papers.why: Code worlds for evolving agents: the environment the learner trains in shapes its future experience.

papers.t: EvolvingWorld: An Open-Schema Framework for Co-Evolving Role-Play Agents and World Model in Interactive Literary World
papers.why: Co-evolves role-play agents and a world model, so the learner and its environment shape each other.

papers.t: Zetta ζ: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence
papers.why: A closed-loop embodied harness for self-evolving physical intelligence: the deployed system adapts its own components over time.

papers.t: Macaron-V1: Towards Open Continual Learning with Self-Improvement and Mixture-of-LoRA
papers.why: Open continual learning with self-improvement and mixture-of-LoRA: the deployed model keeps adapting inside a fixed training process.

papers.t: EvoOntology: A Self-Evolving Ontology Layer for Data Agents
papers.why: A self-evolving ontology layer for data agents, i.e. retained knowledge that changes later behaviour.

papers.t: SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.why: Self-evolving on-policy distillation for agentic reinforcement learning: a fixed training procedure the model runs on itself.

papers.t: AgentOPSD: Recursive Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.why: Recursive self-distillation for agentic reinforcement learning, run under a fixed, human-designed procedure.

papers.t: On-Policy Self-Distillation without Any Supervision
papers.why: On-policy self-distillation without supervision: the model improves from its own outputs under a fixed method.

papers.t: UniEvo-VL: An On-policy Self-Distillation Training Recipe for Multimodal Model Self-improvement
papers.why: An on-policy self-distillation recipe for multimodal self-improvement, a fixed human-designed training procedure.

papers.t: Scaling Trajectories for Complex Tasks through Recursive Self-Rewrite
papers.why: Scales training trajectories through recursive self-rewrite: model-generated data under a fixed generation procedure.

papers.t: Recursive Synthesis for Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks
papers.why: Recursive synthesis of long-horizon terminal tasks: self-generated training data under a fixed procedure.

papers.t: SBCO: Self-Supervised, Verifier-Grounded Harness Optimization For Planning Agents
papers.why: Verifier-grounded harness optimisation for planning agents, positioned against self-referential methods like the Darwin Gödel Machine: the system picks harness edits, with acceptance set by a verifier.

papers.t: MammoClaw: Towards Skill-Evolving Agent Harness for Breast Cancer Mammography Analysis
papers.why: A training-free agent whose skill evolution turns failed trajectories into reusable guidance for later runs, with model weights frozen.

papers.t: Mako: A Self-Evolving Agentic Operating System (SE-AOS) for Autonomous Web Exploitation
papers.why: An agent that treats its exploit capability as a mutable kernel: it observes its own failures, synthesises new capabilities, tests them on a live target and loads them back into itself.

papers.t: Living-Harness Is an Interactive-Agent Evolver
papers.why: A self-evolving harness that converts each completed trajectory and its evaluator signal into revisions of the persistent harness for future tasks.

papers.t: Self-Modifying Lean Proof Agents with Verifier-Grounded Benchmark Coevolution
papers.why: A Lean proof agent whose workflow is evolved rather than hand-designed, with the benchmark co-evolving, so the learner shapes the tasks it faces next.

papers.t: Evo$^2$: Evolving the Evolver through Weight-Harness Co-Evolution
papers.why: Co-evolves model weights and the agent harness and aims to evolve the evolver itself, so the improvement mechanism is what is being improved.

papers.t: Experience Funnel: A State-Policy Alternating Loop for Self-Evolving Agents
papers.why: Alternates between explicit textual state (skills, harnesses) and model weights to turn accumulated experience into reusable competence during deployment.

papers.t: VETR: Execution-Grounded Self-Improving Agent for Symbolic Graphics Reasoning
papers.why: An execution-grounded agent that refines symbolic graphics programs from verified execution traces, under a fixed refinement procedure.

papers.t: RSI-Forge: From Research Papers to Environments for Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.why: Turns published papers into executable environments for self-improvement, i.e. automatically producing the tasks and feedback future learning will use.

papers.t: SPECTRUM: Proximal Spectral Modulation for Looped Self-Distillation
papers.why: Looped self-distillation for code generation: a model repeatedly learns from its own raw outputs under a fixed information budget.

papers.t: CollabFlow: Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Collaboration
papers.why: Recursive self-improvement of multi-agent collaboration: outcomes improve how agents collaborate across later tasks.

papers.t: Self-Evolving Agents via Likelihood-Guided Tool-Space Optimization
papers.why: Tool-space self-evolution: each recurring task type keeps a persistent tool space built from accumulated experience.

papers.t: Predict Before You Modify: Learning Improvement Dynamics for Self-Evolving Agents
papers.why: Learns an editable model of improvement dynamics that predicts a modification's outcome before costly evaluation, improving how improvements are proposed and checked.

papers.t: MetaRSI / RSI2: A Meta-Recursive Self-Improving System for Recursive Self-Improving Systems Themselves
papers.why: A meta-recursive system aimed at improving the model-building machinery itself and applying it beyond machine-checkable benchmarks.

papers.t: HarnessEvolve: Learning from Reference Trajectories for Reliable Agent Self-Evolution
papers.why: Self-evolving agents optimise their harness from environment feedback, using reference trajectories to address credit assignment, shortcut learning and forgetting.

papers.t: Meta$^n$: Recursive Self-Improvement through Emergent Depth
papers.why: Recurses on the meta-operation's own products to reach greater meta-depth, aiming to improve the process that produces answers rather than the answers.

papers.t: SkillZip: Evaluation-Free Skill Compression for Self-Evolving Agents by Discovering Reusable Structure
papers.why: Compresses the skills a self-evolving agent accumulates, keeping retained skills cheap to inject and maintain.

papers.t: When Self-Evolution Backfires: Pre-Commit Gating against Skill Contamination in LLM Agents
papers.why: Shows accumulated skills can contaminate later ones and proposes pre-commit gating to keep self-evolution from degrading performance.

papers.t: From Atomic Actions to Standard Operating Procedures: Iterative Tool Optimization for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
papers.why: Iterative tool optimisation that turns atomic actions into standard operating procedures for self-evolving agents.

papers.t: Agentic Hardware Design as Repository-Level Code Evolution
papers.why: A self-evolving agent loop that evolves a hardware-design repository against an executable evaluator and a fixed acceptance predicate.

papers.t: RSIPO: Recursive Self-Improving Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning via Skill-Policy Co-Evolution
papers.why: Recursive self-improving policy optimisation for agentic RL, combining skills with policy learning under a fixed training procedure.

papers.t: VideoEvoHarness: Self Evolving Agent Harness from Unlabeled Videos for Video Understanding
papers.why: Self-evolves a video-understanding agent harness from unlabelled videos, choosing its own improvements without annotated question-answer data.

papers.t: Self-Evolving Harness on Multiple Tasks with the Agent as Its Own Optimizer
papers.why: The agent acts as its own harness optimiser across multiple tasks, instead of a separate proposer.

papers.t: Hyper Algorithm Design Agent: Evolving Learnable Optimizer from Zero
papers.why: An agent that designs learnable optimisation algorithms from scratch inside a meta-optimisation setup.

papers.t: Memory as Middleware for Self-Improving AI Agents
papers.why: Memory as shared middleware so agents keep durable knowledge of past failures and repairs across sessions.

papers.t: What Stops Recursive Self-Improvement in Robotics? Lessons from 123 Rounds of Agentic Skill Discovery
papers.why: An agent finds a missing robot capability, writes or installs new skills, tests each change in simulation and repeats, studied over 123 rounds.

papers.t: MedRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Medical Agents via Clinically Aligned Self-Evolution
papers.why: Medical agents learn from their own failures and autonomously extend their skills after deployment.

papers.t: Self Improvement via Fast Tree-search
papers.why: A sample-efficient framework in which coding agents improve their own implementations using fast tree search.

papers.t: Knowledge-Centric Self-Improvement
papers.why: Treats accumulated knowledge, not the agent, as the object that improves, so gains transfer across agent designs.

papers.t: Data-Centric Recursive Self-Improvement for Navigation via Policy-Synchronized Language-Action Dual Bootstrapping
papers.why: Data-centric self-improvement for navigation: model-generated language-action data produced under a fixed pipeline.

papers.t: Small but Mighty: Test Suites as Improvement Signals for Self-Evolving Agents
papers.why: Builds better improvement signals (test suites) for deciding which self-rewrites an agent keeps, improving the acceptance check itself.

papers.t: Harmony Harness: Multi-Objective Self-Evolution of Agent Harnesses
papers.why: Multi-objective self-evolution of agent harnesses, evolving components separately instead of as one artifact.

papers.t: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
papers.why: Recursive agent harnessing for open-world tasks, applying self-improvement to the harness-evolution process.

papers.t: Embodied Turing Machines: Stateful Code for Robot Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.why: Stateful code that a robot agent rewrites over time, as an approach to robot recursive self-improvement.

papers.t: Recursive Self-Improvement through Multi-Agent Self-Supervision
papers.why: Multi-agent self-supervision on non-verifiable tasks, where the model acts as its own optimiser and evaluator.

papers.t: EmbodiedRSI: Active Continual Robot Learning Through Hypothesis-Guided Co-Evolution
papers.why: Hypothesis-guided co-evolution for active continual robot learning: the system chooses what to try next to gather useful experience.

papers.t: MedZERO: Self-Evolving Agents for Open-Ended Medical Reasoning Through Controlled Knowledge Accumulation
papers.why: Self-evolving medical agents that improve through iterative task generation and problem solving.

papers.t: Verify Less, Evolve More: Training Idea-Level Critics for Verification-Efficient ML Evolving Agents
papers.why: Trains idea-level critics so self-evolving ML agents verify fewer candidates, improving the evaluation step of the evolution loop.

papers.t: EMHO: EMbodied Agent Harness Optimization via Experience Traces
papers.why: An embodied harness that improves itself from experience traces under sparse feedback.

papers.t: VERSE: Verified Self-Evolving Optimizer for Agent Harnesses
papers.why: A verified self-evolving optimiser that also improves how it diagnoses failures, develops edits and tests them, so the optimiser itself is improved.

papers.t: My FAULT: Self-Diagnosis as Credit Assignment in Self-Evolving Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.why: Self-diagnosis as credit assignment in self-evolving agentic RL, a fixed training procedure.

papers.t: ReSAIL: Mitigating Collapse in Iterative Agent Self-Distillation
papers.why: Mitigates collapse in iterative agent self-distillation across deployment cycles.

papers.t: Mixture of Self-Improving Branches For Agent Harness Optimization
papers.why: Harness optimisation with branches of self-improvement, extending Meta-Harness style iterative code generation and evaluation.

papers.t: Know Thyself, Teach Thyself: Internal Information Flow for Selective Self-Distillation
papers.why: Selective self-distillation guided by internal information flow, a fixed self-training loop.

papers.t: Gödel Forest: Balancing Search Depth and Breadth for Data-Centric Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.why: Data-centric recursive self-improvement: balances search depth and breadth when training the model on agent-generated data.

papers.t: EASE: Behavior-Adaptive Skill Curation for Self-Evolving Agents
papers.why: Behaviour-adaptive curation of the skills a self-evolving agent accumulates.

papers.t: SAGE: A Statistical Acceptance Gate for Self-Evolving Agents
papers.why: A statistical gate that decides whether to accept a self-evolving agent's proposed skill-document edit; the acceptance rule is designed by humans.

papers.t: SkillSandbox: Skill Verification via Dynamic Scenario Synthesis
papers.why: Verifies each distilled skill's reusability using synthesised scenarios, for self-evolving agents that accumulate skills.

reviewed: Top ~75 of 216 arXiv candidates by keyword score reviewed on 2026-10-14; benchmarks, surveys, audits and safety studies were left out.
